name: Smart Shuffle
description: Shuffle with recommended songs mixed in: about one for every three of the list's own, chosen from what the list sounds like. The shuffle button gets a third state.

name: Smart Subtitles
description: Compares subtitle and audio tracks from different sources: the ones that agree with the rest come first and are marked Matching, ones unlike all others get a note.

name: Smooth Motion
description: In-between frames for smoother movement in the video player, made on this device's graphics chip. Adds Smooth motion to the player's Effects, made three ways: Blend, Balanced or Sharp.
